detailGeometry.coordinateConvention: XY screen units, origin top-left. Z screen-equivalent units; negative Z towards camera. All node TRS in original Unity order; perspective not yet applied. Card local XY rectangle340x516, common-card localZ0.05086 included.
detailGeometry.precision: Rest hierarchy exact serialized TRS. Dense rotation samples nlerp sampled at30fps; scalar position curve tangents absent in original_interaction_clips.json: assumed zero-slope Hermite between keys (smoothstep). Keyframes and rest exact, intermediate scalar values provisional. Entry/exit/prev/next clips sampled independently atop entry-final baseline; loop not mixed into those frames. Their sparse scalar/vector curves linearly interpolate per existing pack_source_pages.py because tangents absent.
